## Overview

The no fixed support need is for customers who don’t have a permanent address and need us to make sure their mail is secure and we can contact them effectively.  They may need support with opening accounts or receiving mail securely. The support need makes sure that customers classed as being in a vulnerable group such as the homeless, victims of domestic abuse etc, who aren't able to provide ID and V documents aren't excluded from opening accounts or receiving replacement cards or pins.

## Customers Who May Benefit

Those who are experiencing:

* Bereavement.
* Financial and domestic abuse.
* Homelessness.
* Relationship breakdown.

## How We Can Help - Treatments

* Review the Failed Electronic Identification and Verification (EID and V) - Branch Referral Process for further guidance.
* If the customer is unable to receive mail at their home address, offer an alternative secure address for items such a debit cards or pins to be sent, see Order Replacement Card or PIN Multi-channel Processes. If they are unable to provide an alternative address, we are able to send the card to a branch for them collect.
* When a customer contacts us, ensure we maintain support by verifying that we have the correct contact details on file, including their email address.

## Example Support Need Note

DD/MM/YY: Ms X has no permanent address, mail to be sent to charity (NAME).
